create_recipe_subclass: create a subclass of Recipe that implements create_task to define a custom training workflow
get_model_from_context: get a PyTorch model from a RecipeContext by calling get_model with a section name
bootstrap_reference_model: bootstrap a reference model from a RecipeContext using bootstrap_reference_model with a config section name
create_trainer_with_context: create a Trainer from a RecipeContext by passing a TrainUnit and DataReader to create_trainer
get_config_as_type: get the typed recipe configuration from a RecipeContext by calling get_config_as with a config class
